purpose: Codec-robust audio model (KNOWN_ISSUES.md #14). Committed before any codec feature, training run, dev score or eval score that uses it.
trigger: results/robustness.json (eval sample): after MP3 at 64 kbit/s the served model flags 100% of bona fide utterances. That eval measurement only motivated the work; every choice below is fixed here in advance or made on train and dev data.

conditions.source: ml/preprocessing/audio_codecs.py CODEC_CONDITIONS (ffmpeg bundled with imageio-ffmpeg; encode, then decode to 16 kHz mono PCM; cut or zero-pad to the original length)

training_data: official LA train: every utterance once as distributed and once re-encoded with one condition, assign_condition(utt_id, seed=1, all 11 conditions); cache split train_codec
selection_data: official LA dev: every utterance as distributed plus once re-encoded, assign_condition(utt_id, seed=2, all 11 conditions); cache split dev_codec. Dev EER is pooled over both (each re-encoded utterance is its own trial).

training.hyperparameters: the script defaults used in Phase 2 (AdamW lr 3e-4, weight decay 1e-4, batch 64, 30 epochs at most, patience 10, weighted BCE)

served_seed: of the three, the lowest pooled dev EER (ties: lower seed)
calibration: class-balanced Platt scaling of the mean window spoof logit, fitted on the pooled dev scores of the served seed
verdict_rule: threshold = calibrated probability at the pooled dev EER point; inconclusive band = 0.08 (platform default, fixed in advance); heuristics keep weight 0
replacement_rule: the codec-trained model replaces the current one as the default only if its pooled dev EER is lower than the current model's pooled dev EER on the same dev and dev_codec trials; otherwise it is reported and not served
dev_codec_measurement: the balanced dev subsample of Phase 3 (paper_results/audio_heuristics_dev/subsample.csv, 1,000 bona fide + 1,000 spoofed) in every condition, scored by the current and by the new model
guard_rule: after the freeze: if any condition of a codec family (mp3, aac, opus) has its bona fide utterances on the dev measurement flagged more than 5% of the time under the served model's frozen rule, uploads encoded with that codec get an INCONCLUSIVE verdict with a note saying why (codec read from the file), behind a setting
evaluation: once, after the selection, calibration and freeze are committed: (1) the full LA eval partition as distributed, eval_asvspoof.py --confirm-final-eval; (2) the 4,004-utterance eval sample of paper_results/audio_end_to_end_eval/sample.csv in every condition; (3) end-to-end verdicts on that sample. The earlier model's results stay as they are.

amendment_v2.reason: Dev diagnostic before any codec model was finished: with the served model, 150 bona fide dev utterances resampled 16 kHz -> 48 kHz -> 16 kHz were flagged 97.3% of the time with soxr (the load_audio path for uploads at other rates) and 78.7% with ffmpeg's resampler (the video audio path); Opus decoded by ffmpeg flagged 37.3%, by libsndfile + soxr 0%. Resampling, not only codecs, breaks the model, and nearly every real upload is resampled.
amendment_v2.v1_runs: the three plan-v1 runs (codec conditions only) were stopped at epoch 5 when this was found; they are not used or reported as results
amendment_v2.conditions: the 11 codec conditions plus resample_22k, resample_44k, resample_48k (soxr up and down) and resample_48k_ffmpeg (ffmpeg up and down): ml/preprocessing/audio_codecs.py ALL_CONDITIONS
amendment_v2.training_data: official LA train as distributed plus once with one of the 15 conditions, assign_condition(utt_id, seed=3); cache split train_codec2
amendment_v2.selection_data: official LA dev as distributed plus once with one of the 15 conditions, assign_condition(utt_id, seed=4); cache split dev_codec2; dev EER pooled over both
amendment_v2.checkpoints: audio_lcnn_asvspoof_lfcc_codec2_seed{0,1,2}.pt; training, seed choice, calibration, verdict rule and replacement rule as in v1 with dev_codec2 in place of dev_codec
amendment_v2.dev_codec_measurement: as in v1, over all 15 conditions plus the original
amendment_v2.guard_rule: as in v1, over the families mp3, aac, opus and resample; the resample family applies to uploads whose first audio stream is not at 16 kHz
